findings.description: String filenames are no longer wrapped as a single path, so existing calls such as `click.edit(filename="notes.txt")` pass individual characters as filenames to the editor.
findings.rationale: When `filename` is a string, the new `isinstance(filename, os.PathLike)` check is false. The string reaches `edit_files` as an iterable of characters, causing the editor to open files named after those characters instead of the requested file. Include `str` alongside `os.PathLike` in the check.
